symptoms_seen: Long, cigar-shaped grey to tan lesions on the leaves
Lesions joining up and drying whole leaf sections
Lower and middle leaves most affected
treatment: Remove badly infected lower leaves and burn or bury them away from the farm
Do not leave maize stalks on the field after harvest: feed, burn or plough them in
Keep the field weeded and avoid overcrowding so leaves dry quickly
If more than half the leaves are affected before tasselling, a fungicide with mancozeb or a triazole from an agro-dealer can help: wear gloves and a mask and follow the label
prevention: Plant resistant varieties recommended by your ADP or seed company
Rotate maize with groundnut, beans or soybean for at least one season
Plant early with the first good rains and use recommended spacing
answer.see_extension_officer: If the lesions reach the leaves above the cob before the grain fills, or many farms around you show the same signs.

symptoms_seen: Dogayen tabo masu launin toka a kan ganye
Tabon suna haɗuwa suna bushe ganye
Ganyen ƙasa da na tsakiya sun fi kamuwa
treatment: Cire ganyen da suka lalace sosai, ka ƙone su ko ka binne su nesa da gona
Kada ka bar karan masara a gona bayan girbi
Ka yi noman ciyawa kuma kada ka cunkushe shuka
Idan cutar ta kama fiye da rabin ganye kafin fitar gashi, ana iya amfani da maganin fungicide (mancozeb) daga shagon kayan gona: ka sa safar hannu da takunkumi, ka bi umarnin kwali
prevention: Shuka irin masara mai jure cuta da ADP ta ba da shawara
Canza amfanin gona: shuka gyaɗa ko wake bayan masara
Shuka da wuri da ruwan sama na farko, da tazara mai kyau
answer_ha.see_extension_officer: Idan tabon sun kai ganyen da ke saman kai kafin ƙwaya ta cika, ko gonaki da yawa a kusa suna da irin wannan alama.

symptoms_seen: Brown spots with yellow halos on older leaves
Some spots show faint rings like a target
treatment: Pick off spotted lower leaves and burn them
Water at the base of the plant in the morning, not on the leaves
Mulch with dry grass so soil does not splash onto leaves
If it keeps spreading, spray a copper or mancozeb fungicide from an agro-dealer every 7 to 10 days: wear gloves and a mask and follow the label
prevention: Do not plant tomato, pepper or garden egg on the same bed two seasons running
Stake plants so leaves stay off the ground
answer.see_extension_officer: If the spots reach the fruits or the top of the plant, or more than a quarter of plants are affected.

symptoms_seen: Tabo masu ruwan ƙasa da gefe mai rawaya a tsofaffin ganye
treatment: Cire ganyen ƙasa masu tabo ka ƙone su
Ka shayar a gindin shuka da safe, ba a kan ganye ba
Ka rufe ƙasa da busasshiyar ciyawa
Idan tana yaɗuwa, ka fesa maganin copper ko mancozeb duk kwana 7 zuwa 10: ka sa safar hannu da takunkumi, ka bi umarnin kwali
prevention: Kada ka shuka tumatur, barkono ko yalo a wuri ɗaya shekara biyu a jere
Ka tallafa wa shuka da sanda don ganye kada su taɓa ƙasa
Ka yi amfani da iri mai tsabta
answer_ha.see_extension_officer: Idan tabon sun kai 'ya'yan itace ko saman shuka, ko fiye da kashi ɗaya cikin huɗu na shuke-shuke sun kamu.

symptoms_seen: Large brown, dead patches spreading from the leaf edge
Pale green to yellow tissue around the patches
treatment: Remove and burn infected leaves and badly hit plants at once: this spreads fast in cool, wet weather
Do not compost infected plants
Spray a copper-based or mancozeb fungicide from an agro-dealer before more rain: wear gloves and a mask and follow the label
prevention: Give plants space for air to move
Avoid overhead watering in the evening
Destroy volunteer tomato and potato plants near the farm
answer.see_extension_officer: Straight away if several plants show it after rain: late blight can wipe out a field in a week.

symptoms_seen: Manyan tabo masu ruwan ƙasa da suka mutu daga gefen ganye
Kore mai haske zuwa rawaya a kewayen tabon
treatment: Cire ka ƙone ganye da shuke-shuke masu cutar nan da nan: tana yaɗuwa da sauri lokacin sanyi da ruwa
Kada ka sa shuka mai cuta a taki
Ka fesa maganin copper ko mancozeb kafin ruwan sama na gaba: ka sa safar hannu da takunkumi, ka bi umarnin kwali
prevention: Ka bar tazara don iska ta ratsa
Kada ka shayar ta saman ganye da yamma
Ka lalata tumatur da dankalin turawa da suka fito da kansu kusa da gona
answer_ha.see_extension_officer: Nan take idan shuke-shuke da yawa sun nuna alamar bayan ruwan sama: wannan cuta na iya lalata gona cikin mako guda.
